d:
Tamil Nadu has raised the upper age limit for TNPSC direct recruitment by five years, offering relief to thousands of government job aspirants. But with thousands of vacancies across government departments and intense competition for limited posts, will this decision address the larger recruitment crisis? In this episode of Focus Tamil Nadu, we examine the age relaxation, recruitment delays, vacant posts and the challenges facing TNPSC aspirants.
Thank you for watching our video!
